svg.aria-label: Two views of the same hill. Side view, with height lines every 100 metres from 1000 to 1400 metres: two peaks with a saddle between them, a steep left face where contour lines sit close, and a flat bench on the right before the last drop. From above, the same hill as brown contour lines: rings around each peak, an orange dashed ridge joining the peaks through the saddle, a cliff where the lines nearly touch on the north face, a bench where two lines spread wide apart, a draw where the lines make a V pointing uphill, and a spur where the lines make a V pointing downhill.
